transcript.content: Hello, it’s good to meet you. What brings you in today?
I... I'm here because I've been eating very little lately and skipping most of my meals. My weight has been dropping quite a bit recently, so I thought I should probably get checked out.
Are you trying to lose weight because you feel fat or are very afraid of gaining weight, even though others may say you’re already thin?

Yes, I am absolutely terrified of gaining even a single pound. When I look in the mirror, I still see so much fat, so I feel like I need to lose more weight. Everyone else tells me I'm already too thin, but I just don't see it that way at all.
Besides your weight or body fat, are you mainly preoccupied with some other specific part of your appearance that you believe looks defective or ugly?

No, I'm not really worried about other defects like my face or skin. My main concern is strictly about being too fat and how big my stomach and thighs look. I just feel overweight and want my body to be smaller.
Have you become significantly underweight for your age and height, or has a doctor told you your weight is dangerously low?

Yes, my doctor told me that my weight is dangerously low and that I am severely underweight. But honestly, I still feel like I need to lose more weight, and I absolutely refuse to gain any of it back.
